/home/kenma/personal/coding/indoor-detec.method: Inspección visual de las 99 imágenes asignadas mediante overlays de cajas e IDs GT, con crops ampliados de cada objeto en escenas densas y ampliaciones adicionales. Sin predicciones ni resultados del detector. Ropa de cama habitual no se cuenta como obstáculo externo; recorte por borde separado.

metadata.label_origin: AI visual inspection of existing photographs, with author review markers when present
metadata.area_definition: COCO bbox width * height / full image width * height

bootstrap.unit: whole capture_group, all six configurations retained

metadata.false_positives: No occlusion assigned: predictions have no GT visibility label

prediction_metadata.timing_scope: JPEG replay; camera acquisition, UI and speech excluded

limitations: Labels began as AI judgments; author review markers are preserved, and independent human validation remains pending.
Occlusion describes obstruction by another object; frame truncation is recorded separately.
Severity is a qualitative visible-instance judgment, not a measured hidden-area percentage.
Class and apparent box size can confound severity associations; stratified tables are descriptive.
Boxes use the existing annotation extent; area is not full hidden-object area.
Bootstrap intervals cover capture-group variability only, not labeling/model uncertainty.
Capture groups follow provisional filename ordering and may share rooms; intervals may be optimistic.
Recall describes existing annotated GT instances; fully hidden, unannotated and out-of-frame targets are excluded.
No cross-image instance identity is available; associations do not establish a causal occlusion effect.
Android predictions replay iPhone photos on an emulator; this does not test live camera or speech performance.
